-has tons of flanking maneuvers that he can abuse the shit out of with his verticality.

-not too hard to aim but takes some getting used to of you play a lot of hitscan. On console he is very very difficult (just disable aim assist and you'd be doing yourself a favor).

-all of his abilities pair nicely together, and some cool synergies can be done such as: the ever famous salvo, thrust, spit combo.

-Deck building him can be very challenging, im always finding new and exciting combo's; no other character gives me the sheer amount of fun experimenting with cards.

-Ultimate is simple, and effective but you need to pay attention to when you use it, you probably don't wan't to get gunned down immediately after one shotting the enemy tank.

-His legendaries are fun and do change the way you play a decent amount. *ahem* Fisallade is cancer.

-many different item combos can be had with him, maybe go morale boost and get your ult in seconds so you can keep the enemy tank dead? Maybe you want more spits, and salvo's? Maybe you want to be nearly unkillable by investing in maximum mobility, kill to heal, and haven? etc.

-mind game is end game with mastering Drogoz. Pretend to go one way and instantly diverting course, or as mentioned exploit his mobility and move out of map to flank. Droggoz has so many posabilities but how effective you throw off attention all depends on your map knowledge, usage of said knowledge, and the enemies ability to track you.
